instructions: List all questions in the following query, separated by new line and every question start with a '+'.
Questions can be one of the following types: SINGLE_CHOICE, MULTIPLE_CHOICE, TRUE_FALSE, FILL_OUT_BLANKS.
If the question is SINGLE_CHOICE, options are separated by a semicolon; the first option is the correct one.
If MULTIPLE_CHOICE, mark correct options with '(c)' at the end.
If TRUE_FALSE, use 'true' or 'false' as option.
If FILL_OUT_BLANKS, replace blanks in the text with '<_____>' and list parts for blanks separated by ';' in order.
Consider the language of the query and the language of the answers as given in the 'language' section.
example-input: - query: 'The capital of Germany is Berlin. Germany is a country in Europe.'- language: 'The language of the query is english; the language of the answers should be in english'+ SINGLE_CHOICE | What is the capital of Germany? | Berlin; Munich; Hamburg; Frankfurt+ TRUE_FALSE | The capital of Germany is Dresden. | false+ FILL_OUT_BLANKS | The capital of Germany is <_____>. | Berlin+ MULTIPLE_CHOICE | What is a country in europe? | Germany(c); Canada; China; France(c)
